item.title: Jonathan Blow – If AI solved coding, why is my software still the same? [video]
item.summary: Game developer Jonathan Blow discusses why current AI coding tools have not fundamentally transformed complex software development. Watch the video to explore his perspective on the limitations of AI in coding.
